title: JumpDeath
description: This plugin is made for who create challenge videos like minecraft but i can't jump.
body:
JumpDeath is a simple yet fun challenge-based plugin designed for content creators and multiplayer events. With this plugin enabled, any player who jumps will be instantly eliminated, turning even the smallest movement into a high-risk decision.
Perfect for YouTube challenges, SMP events, and unique gameplay scenarios, JumpDeath adds a layer of tension and creativity to your server. Players must think carefully before making any move, as even a single jump can lead to instant death.
Features:
Instant death on jump
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Ideal for challenge videos and content creation
Easy to use with plug-and-play setup.
